Canonical same-lock embedded bundle preserves main service views plus reviewed Secrets ACK/read and Login keyboard changes. Existing reveal/epoch binding covers only its finite correspondence, not minification, keyboard chooser, all JavaScript or erasure. New source/build/browser and immutable gates are independent evidence. Reviewed accessibility-only refresh disables Cloudscape motion within the Secrets view, with exact-English locale normalization and strengthened immediate-alert contrast regression checks. Existing finite state bindings are retained; animation/opacity/accessibility are outside these models and require executable browser evidence. New hosted exact-HEAD full gates remain required.

models.limits: Finite explicit-retrieve/display model, not React, DOM, AbortController, memory zeroization or implementation refinement. Only the successful response path is modeled; native store/IAM must authorize before returning any secret. A returned ARN can differ and must be rejected. Retrieve, Hide and navigation invalidate epochs; unmount also clears visible state. Parent must remount on region/principal changes. Emission history captures the context at each acceptance so later Hide/navigation cannot relabel an earlier stale acceptance. Draft entry, mutation atomicity and form layout are outside this model. Parent main.jsx scope binds only Secrets routing/remount key (region/principal/navigation); the generated app.js binding is the canonical compiled artifact of those source inputs, independently checked by bundle/asset hashes. It does not model unrelated existing console services or prove JavaScript compilation.
